def policy(me, opponent, memory):
    # Generate all empty positions

    # Check predefined key points first

        (4,4), (4,16), (16,4), (16,16),  # corners
        (4,10), (10,4), (10,16), (16,10), (10,10),  # other star points

    for point in key_points:
        if point in candidates:
            return (point, memory)
    # If none found, go for max score based on heuristics
    # Define a scoring function
    best_move = None
    best_score = -inf
    for (i,j) in candidates:
        # Calculate distance from center (10,10)
        distance = abs(i-10) + abs(j-10)
        # Count adjacent my stones
        my_adj = 0
        opp_adj = 0
        for di, dj in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
            ni, nj = i + di, j + dj
            if (ni, nj) in me:
                my_adj += 1
            elif (ni, nj) in opponent:
                opp_adj += 1
        # Compute score
        score = -distance + 3*my_adj - 2*opp_adj  # weights can be adjusted

        if i in [1,19] or j in [1,19]:
            score += 5
        if score > best_score:
            best_score = score
            best_move = (i,j)
    return (best_move, memory)
